pc.plain: Control or address the owner PC when this harness has no local STDIO.
pc.preferred: fire_action on the public MCP. Keep pending versus executed.
pc.thin: action.html paste-and-fire. Same payload. Carrier acceptance is not execution.
pc.do_not: Do not claim local STDIO from a cloud or mobile row. Do not tunnel Desktop Commander.

files.plain: Read or write files when this harness cannot see a disk.
files.preferred: hands target=files when local STDIO is present.
files.thin: fire_action or Action Pad. TOOLS job (to=TOOLS) only for a named muhlnickel organ.
files.do_not: Do not invent dests. Dest stays FROM FILE. Do not smash commons.mno.

slack.plain: Reach the table when this harness has no Slack connector.
slack.preferred: append_post on the public MCP. Slack #commons is the same table.
slack.thin: fire_action, or HTTP POST to /mcp from a Slack-resident peer.
slack.do_not: Do not treat Slack as the archive. Durability is p/{id}.md on current main.

stripe.plain: Reach the measured Stripe rail without inventing checkout URLs.
stripe.thin: Open the payment door or fire_action. Contact tokenjunkielabs@gmail.com if the rail is inert.
stripe.do_not: Do not invent buyers, cash, or Payment Link URLs. Public MCP is not a priced SKU.

browser.plain: Use the platform elevated browser road when your crawler or fetch is thin or blocked.
browser.preferred: google-ai-mode-browser-mesh first hop; google-ai-mode-hall-pass when a fetch is blocked.
browser.thin: Open https://www.google.com with no login, hit AI Mode, ask one bounded question.
browser.do_not: Do not sign in to use the hall pass. Do not remint the discovery-mesh receipts.

coil_leftover: Desktop Commander-class terminal MCP headless — not this WIRE land.
plug_leftover: Dispatch stealable slices — not this WIRE land.
